newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: SWEDISH DELEGATION TO FOCUS ON PRIVATISATION.
newsitem.headline: SWEDISH DELEGATION TO FOCUS ON PRIVATISATION.

text.p: Swedish Minister for Industry and Trade Anders Sundstrom met Wednesday with Lithuania's European Affairs Minister Laima Andrikiene to discuss privatisation and export promotion, the European Affairs Ministry said.
Sundstrom led a delegation from the Ministry of Industry and Trade, the Swedish Foreign Ministry and others, the euro ministry said in a statement.
"The delegation was interested in the government's programme for carrying out privatisation of strategic objects, export promotion and the expansion of free trade zones," the statement said.

"Minister Andrikiene familiarised the delegation with the economic situation in Lithuania, the privatisation programme and the government's bid for membership in the European Union," the statement said.
